answer: Paying a toll of 55 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. Every entry must show Dyebound dye engrosser dye warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant dye engrossers show after engrossing room trials. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The tally keeps ivory. The raven is checked, not assumed. One plume, one entry.
